rules.title: Semantic versioning
rules.text: Follow semantic versioning and bump versions only in release changes.

rules.title: Keep a changelog
rules.text: Record user-visible changes in CHANGELOG.md under an Unreleased heading.

rules.title: Feature flags
rules.text: Gate risky or incomplete features behind a flag and remove the flag once fully rolled out.

rules.title: Expand and contract migrations
rules.text: Ship database changes in backward compatible steps: add, backfill, switch reads, then remove.

rules.title: Plan the rollback
rules.text: Make every release reversible and note the rollback path in the pull request.

rules.title: No manual release steps
rules.text: Automate releases in CI; do not rely on manual steps run from a laptop.

rules.title: Release via workflow
rules.text: Cut releases through the release workflow, never by creating tags by hand.

rules.title: Write the release note
rules.text: Write the user-facing release note in the PR description or changeset, in the project format.

rules.title: Canary first
rules.text: Publish risky changes to a canary or pre-release channel before the stable one.
